Title: Clearer menus & classic adventures
Changes: Redesigned the expedition screen with clearer destination cards and simpler controls.
Choose your character after selecting a Reef or City expedition, before starting the run.
Classic Play starts in Thornmeadow, even after choosing a Reef or City expedition.
A new What's New window shows changes once per version and can be reopened from the main menu.
Flick now wields Stormfang Blades: twin returning blades that hit enemies while standing or moving.
